skill.name: check-migration
skill.description: Validates Flyway migration files for version conflicts, naming rules, simple SQL conventions, and main branch migration conflicts.
skill.summary: Checks Flyway migration files before merge to reduce database release issues.
skill.author: Crearize

security_audit.summary: Most external-command detections are Markdown fences or inline filename examples, so they are false positives. One Git command block is confirmed because it asks the agent to run git fetch and git diff, including network access, without an explicit confirmation step. The high entropy heuristic is a false positive caused by normal Japanese markdown content.

remediation.issue: Git branch comparison uses external commands and network access.
remediation.suggestion: Add a note requiring user confirmation before git fetch, and inspect the repository remote before network access.

content.value_statement: Migration conflicts can break deployments and delay releases. This skill checks Flyway versions, naming, SQL conventions, and main branch conflicts.
actual_capabilities: Lists migration files in the configured backend migration directory.
Finds Flyway files that match the expected versioned filename pattern.
Checks version continuity, duplicate versions, and missing numbers.
Checks filenames against the documented Flyway naming rule.
Compares branch migration files against origin/main for conflicts.
Reports total files, latest version, check results, and next steps.
limitations: Performs simple SQL checks, not full SQL parsing.
Requires access to the repository main branch for conflict checks.
Does not execute Flyway or apply database migrations.

use_cases.title: Pre-merge migration review
use_cases.description: Check a pull request for duplicate Flyway versions and naming issues before it reaches main.

use_cases.title: Release readiness check
use_cases.description: Confirm that pending database migrations have clear sequence numbers and no main branch conflicts.

use_cases.title: Database change quality gate
use_cases.description: Add a lightweight review step for SQL migration conventions before deeper integration testing.

prompt_templates.title: Run a basic check
prompt_templates.prompt: Use check-migration to review the Flyway migrations in this repository. Summarize any naming, version, or SQL convention issues.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review before opening a pull request.

prompt_templates.title: Compare with main
prompt_templates.prompt: Use check-migration to compare my branch with origin/main and identify migration version conflicts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Branch review after recent main branch changes.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a conflict
prompt_templates.prompt: Use check-migration to inspect migration versions and explain which files need renumbering or review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Troubleshooting duplicate or missing migration versions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a release report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use check-migration to produce a release-ready migration report with file counts, latest version, conflict status, and next steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release validation for a database change set.

output_examples.input: Review migrations before opening a pull request.
output_examples.output: The report identifies the total migration count, latest version, duplicate status, naming status, branch conflict status, and next action.

output_examples.input: Check whether my branch conflicts with main.
output_examples.output: The result explains whether the branch adds migration files that overlap with main branch versions.
The summary gives a concise readiness decision and highlights issues that require manual database review.

best_practices: Run the check from the repository root with the intended branch checked out.
Review the configured remote before allowing any main branch comparison.
Follow this check with full migration tests for production database changes.
anti_patterns: Relying on filename checks as a complete SQL validation process.
Renaming migrations that were already applied to shared environments.
Running branch comparison against an untrusted or unexpected remote.

faq.question: What migration format does this skill expect?
faq.answer: It expects Flyway versioned SQL files that use a V number, double underscore, and descriptive filename.

faq.question: Does it run database migrations?
faq.answer: No. It reviews files and reports issues. It does not apply changes to a database.

faq.question: Can it replace Flyway validation?
faq.answer: No. It is a lightweight review aid. Use Flyway and database tests for final validation.

faq.question: Does it compare my branch with main?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a branch comparison step against origin/main for migration file conflicts.

faq.question: Can it detect duplicate migration versions?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to check duplicate versions, missing numbers, and version continuity.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
